title: How to Review an SAT Practice Test (The Right Way)
description:
Taking practice tests doesn't raise your SAT score by itself. Reviewing them does. This is a step-by-step method for reviewing a Bluebook practice test so the same mistakes stop coming back.

You'll learn:
• Why reviewing beats taking more tests
• What My Practice shows you after a Bluebook practice test
• Why you should redo every miss cold before reading the explanation
• The five kinds of misses: content gap, misread, careless, timing, guessed right
• The mistake-log columns that matter
• How to find similar questions in the free SAT Suite Question Bank
• A weekly review loop

Any example questions shown are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank and the full-length practice tests in Bluebook.
